title: City crews find a vintage Mountain Dew bottle buried under concrete
excerpt: Laredo Utilities crews turned up a bit of buried history overnight — a vintage glass Mountain Dew bottle, found under the concrete during utility work.
content:
City of Laredo Utilities Department crews found a small piece of buried history during their work — a vintage glass Mountain Dew bottle, unearthed from beneath the concrete.

The department shared the find early Friday morning, Nov. 13, 2026, calling the old bottle a “hidden treasure” found under all that concrete.

The department did not say where the work was taking place or how old the bottle is.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department, Nov. 13, 2026.
